title: 第25课 · 他恐怕去不了
subtitle: Lesson 25 — 他恐怕去不了 · He probably can't go

items.py: Tā kǒngpà qù bu liǎo.
Nǐ kàn de dǒng Zhōngwén bàozhǐ ma?
Wǒ kàn bu dǒng.
Zhème duō cài, chī de wán ma?
items.en: So many dishes, can you finish them?

items.py: Chī bu wán.
Nǐ tīng de jiàn ma?
Tīng bu jiàn, qǐng dà shēng yīdiǎnr.
items.en: I can't hear, please speak louder.

items.zh: 玛丽：明天我们去爬香山，大卫去吗？
items.py: Mǎlì: Míngtiān wǒmen qù pá Xiāng Shān, Dàwèi qù ma?
items.en: Mary: We're climbing Fragrant Hills tomorrow, is David going?

items.py: Liú Jīng: Tā kǒngpà qù bu liǎo.
items.en: Liu Jing: He probably can't go.

items.py: Mǎlì: Wèi shénme?

items.zh: 刘京：他感冒了，身体不舒服。
items.py: Liú Jīng: Tā gǎnmào le, shēntǐ bù shūfu.
items.en: Liu Jing: He caught a cold, he's not feeling well.

items.py: Mǎlì: Nà tài kěxī le.

items.zh: 刘京：下次他一定去得了。
items.py: Liú Jīng: Xià cì tā yīdìng qù de liǎo.
items.en: Liu Jing: He can definitely go next time.

items.zh: 张老师：这篇课文你看得懂吗？
items.py: Zhāng lǎoshī: Zhè piān kèwén nǐ kàn de dǒng ma?
items.en: Teacher Zhang: Can you understand this text?

items.zh: 大卫：有些生词看不懂，可是大部分看得懂。
items.py: Dàwèi: Yǒuxiē shēngcí kàn bu dǒng, kěshì dà bùfen kàn de dǒng.
items.en: David: Some new words I can't understand, but most of it I can.

items.zh: 张老师：很好。这些练习你做得完吗？
items.py: Zhāng lǎoshī: Hěn hǎo. Zhèxiē liànxí nǐ zuò de wán ma?
items.en: Teacher Zhang: Good. Can you finish these exercises?

items.py: Dàwèi: Zuò de wán, méi wèntí.

items.zh: 张老师：你听得见后面同学说话吗？
items.py: Zhāng lǎoshī: Nǐ tīng de jiàn hòumiàn tóngxué shuō huà ma?
items.en: Teacher Zhang: Can you hear the students in the back talking?

items.zh: 大卫：听不见，他们说得太小声了。
items.py: Dàwèi: Tīng bu jiàn, tāmen shuō de tài xiǎo shēng le.
items.en: David: I can't hear them, they're speaking too quietly.

data.topic: 语法 · Grammar (Potential Complement V得/不 + Result)

items.py: kàn de dǒng / kàn bu dǒng
tīng de jiàn / tīng bu jiàn
chī de wán / chī bu wán
qù de liǎo / qù bu liǎo
zuò de wán / zuò bu wán
mǎi de dào / mǎi bu dào
zhǎo de dào / zhǎo bu dào

items.zh: 你看得懂中文报纸吗？——看得懂。
items.py: Nǐ kàn de dǒng Zhōngwén bàozhǐ ma? —— Kàn de dǒng.
items.en: Can you read Chinese newspapers? — Yes.

items.zh: 你听得懂上海话吗？——听不懂。
items.py: Nǐ tīng de dǒng Shànghǎi huà ma? —— Tīng bu dǒng.
items.en: Can you understand Shanghai dialect? — No.

items.zh: 这些作业你今天做得完吗？
items.py: Zhèxiē zuòyè nǐ jīntiān zuò de wán ma?
items.en: Can you finish this homework today?

items.zh: 这个字太小了，我看不见。
items.py: Zhège zì tài xiǎo le, wǒ kàn bu jiàn.
items.en: This character is too small, I can't see it.

items.zh: 票买得到吗？——恐怕买不到。
items.py: Piào mǎi de dào ma? —— Kǒngpà mǎi bu dào.
items.en: Can you get tickets? — Probably not.
